AtlasScoreRequest.description:
Request schema for /v1/atlas-{ppi,pli}/score.

A-side is always protein sequences. For PPI the B-side is also protein
sequences; for PLI the B-side is SMILES or SELFIES strings.
AtlasScoreRequest.title: AtlasScoreRequest

AtlasScoreResponse.description: Atlas PPI or PLI score result.

BatchManifestResponse.description: Versioned batch manifest with chunk locations, counts, and terminal states.

BatchResultRecord.description: One JSON Lines result or error record from a batch chunk.

manifest.description: Batch manifest when it is already available.

CompactActome.description: Compact graph extracted from the full square (Q+P) by (Q+P) proteome-mode score matrix, including query-query scores. The dense full matrix is not returned in this payload.

CompactActomeEdge.description: Zero-based endpoint indices and uint8 confidence s in the range 0 through 100.

DeepResearchJobStatusResponse.description: Deep research report state and step progress.

ErrorResponse.description: Named Gateway error envelope. The detail member can be text or a structured billing or validation object.

ExpansionEnvelope.description: Client expansion data. proteome_scores_b64 is a one-dimensional uint8 vector aligned with proteome_ids after maximum aggregation across queries. candidate_matrix_b64 is a row-major candidate-only C by C uint8 matrix. This envelope does not contain the separately computed full (Q+P) by (Q+P) actome matrix.

proteome_scores_b64.description: One uint8 score per proteome_ids entry, aggregated by maximum across query rows.

HealthReadyResponse.description: Readiness of the Gateway's dependencies, each with ok and latency_ms.

JobPartialResponse.description: Named partial result selected by field_name.

JobResultResponse.description: Job-type-specific result. Known network members are typed; other job families may add explicitly service-specific members.

ProtifyResultsResponse.description: Protify metrics, plots, weights, and Hub metadata.

SharedAnalysisResponse.description: Public share metadata, plus job metadata when optional bearer authentication succeeds.

TmapTree.description: TMAP coordinates and spanning-tree links for visualization. The edges are layout-tree links and must not be interpreted as the underlying PPI or PLI interaction network.

html.description: Self-contained TMAP HTML suitable for a sandboxed srcdoc frame.

TmapTreeEdge.description: One edge of the TMAP layout spanning tree. It is a visualization link, not an asserted biological interaction edge.
